name: Deserpidine
aliases: 11-demethoxyreserpine, 11-desmethoxyreserpine, canescine, Canescine, Deserpidina, Deserpidinum, Harmonyl, Harmonyl®
summary: Deserpidine (INN) or reserpidine (USAN) is an antihypertensive drug structurally related to reserpine differing only by the absence of a methoxy group on the indole ring. It is a naturally occurring alkaloid from Rauvolfia spp.
